entries.title: Ministry of Defence: Defence Capability Plan released
entries.notes: $12 billion over four years, $9 billion new; defence spending to exceed 2% of GDP within eight years.

entries.title: Climate Change Commission: 2026 Monitoring report, Emissions reduction (summary page)
entries.notes: Second emissions budget at increasing risk; recent government actions to reduce emissions likely outweighed by actions that increase them; 2030 methane target not projected to be met.
